patches.title: Reject invalid block switches before decoder state corruption
patches.description: Backports the upstream Brotli decoder fix so malformed block-switch input is returned as a permanent format error rather than accepted as a need for more input.

dep3.origin: Backport of the upstream maintenance-branch fix, applied after Ubuntu's existing quilt patches.

tests.baselineExpectation: The vulnerable decoder remains at NEEDS_MORE_OUTPUT (result/error 3) after reaching the fixture's strict 32 MiB/8,192-call bound, rather than reporting block-switch error -17; normal compression round-trip still succeeds.
tests.patchedExpectation: The patched decoder reports decoder error value -17 (BROTLI_DECODER_ERROR_FORMAT_BLOCK_SWITCH) while processing the bounded malformed stream, and a valid encode/decode round trip succeeds.
